faq.title: ብዙ ጊዜ የሚጠየቁ ጥያቄዎች
faq.a1: ዓለም አቀፍ ደንቦች ሁሉንም ዝውውሮች — ግላዊ (P2P) እና ንግዳዊ (B2B) — ይጠይቃሉ። Bridge (FinCEN፣ አሜሪካ MSB) ያደርጋዋል፣ OmniPay አይደለም። አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ።
faq.a2: ግላዊ ዝውውር (P2P): ወዲያውኑ ማለት ይቻላል — Bridge ክፍያውን ወደ ማንኛውም 41+ ተቀባይ አገሮች በደቂቃዎች ውስጥ ያካሂዳል። ንግዳዊ ክፍያ (B2B): 4–5 የሥራ ቀናት (Stripe+Wise) ወይም 1–2 ቀናት (Bridge Wire)።
faq.a3: አይደለም — ለግላዊም ሆነ ለንግዳዊ ዝውውር። Bridge ብቻ AES-256 ምስጠራ ተጠቅሞ ያካሂዳቸዋል።
faq.q4: KYC ካደረግሁ በኋላ ገጹን ከዘጋሁ ምን ይሆናል?
faq.a4: P2P: ወደ ኦሪጂናሉ ሊንክ ይመለሱ — ስርዓቱ በራስሰር ይቀጥላል። B2B: አሁንም ተመሳሳይ።
faq.a5: P2P: OmniPay 0.50% + $0.49 · Bridge ~0.75% · FX ትርፍ የለም። B2B Stripe+Wise: Stripe 2.9% + Wise ~0.5% + OmniPay 1%። ትክክለኛ የገበያ ዋጋ።
faq.q6: በዝውውሩ ወቅት የቴክኒክ ብልሽት ቢፈጠር ምን ይሆናል?
faq.a6: Bridge የመጨረሻውን ክፍያ ከማረጋገጡ በፊት ስርዓቱ ቢከሽፍ፣ ገንዘቡ ወዲያውኑ ለላኪው ይመለሳል። ምንም ነገር አይወዛወዝም፡ Bridge ተቀባዩ ትክክለኛ ክፍያ እንደተቀበለ እስካረጋገጠ ድረስ ገንዘብ አይለቅም። ችግሩ ከቀጠለ፣ ከዋናው ገጽ ድጋፋችንን ያነጋግሩ።

recibir.kyc_why: ዓለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን ለማክበርና ገንዘብዎን ለመጠበቅ፣ አቅራቢያችን Bridge (FinCEN-ምዝገባ MSB) ማንነትዎን ያረጋግጣል።
recibir.kyc_li2: ዋጋ ያለው መታወቂያ ብቻ ያስፈልጋል (ፓስፖርት ወይም መታወቂያ ካርድ)
recibir.kyc_li3: አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ይደረጋል — ዳግም አይደለም
recibir.kyc_li4: ሰነዶችዎ በBridge ይሰናዳሉ፣ OmniPay በሆነ ሳይሆን
recibir.kyc_footer: Bridge Building Inc. · FinCEN-ምዝገባ MSB (አሜሪካ) · AES-256 ምስጠራ
recibir.kyc_ready_body: ወደ Bridge ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ፖርታል ይወሰዳሉ። ሲጠናቀቅ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ።
recibir.kyc_need1: ዋጋ ያለው ፓስፖርት ወይም መታወቂያ ካርድ
recibir.kyc_secure: 100% ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ሂደት · Bridge Building Inc.
recibir.polling_body: ሰነድዎን ደህንነቱ ተጠብቆ እያረጋገጥን ነው። ጥቂት ሰከንዶች ሊወስድ ይችላል።
recibir.polling_wait: ከ2 ደቂቃ ቢበልጥ ይህን መስኮት ዝጉ ወደ ሌላ ጊዜ ተመሳሳዩን ሊንክ ተጠቅሙ።
recibir.done_body: ማንነትዎ ተረጋግጧል። {sender} የክፍያ መመሪያዎችን በቀጥታ ይቀበላሉ — ተጨማሪ ምንም ማድረግ አያስፈልግዎም።
recibir.done_what_next_body: {sender} በስክሪናቸው ላይ የባንክ ዝውውር መመሪያዎች ያያሉ። ዝውውሩ ሲጠናቀቅ ገንዘቡ በጥቂት ደቂቃዎች ውስጥ ወደ ሂሳብዎ ይደርሳል።
recibir.completing_body: We're setting up your account to receive the money. Just a few seconds.
recibir.done_send_whatsapp: Send payment link to {sender} via WhatsApp

enviar_empresa.title: Business Payment
enviar_empresa.subtitle: Pay a supplier or company with a card · Wise transfers to the recipient's bank
enviar_empresa.amount_hint: Amount in the destination currency. Minimum $20 USD equivalent.
enviar_empresa.fee_note: Exchange rate at time of payment. Mid-market rate, no markup.
enviar_empresa.delivery_note: 4–5 business days via Wise · No KYB required
enviar_empresa.pay_subtitle: Secure payment with credit or debit card
enviar_empresa.done_body: Your payment was processed successfully. Wise will transfer the funds to the recipient's bank within the next business days.
enviar_empresa.done_timeline_body: 4–5 business days · Wise will notify when the transfer is complete

enviar_empresa_wire.title: Business Wire Transfer
enviar_empresa_wire.subtitle: Pay a supplier via wire transfer · Bridge settles to the recipient's bank in 1–2 days
enviar_empresa_wire.amount_hint: Amount in the recipient's local currency. Minimum $100 equivalent.
enviar_empresa_wire.delivery_note: 1–2 business days · KYB required for recipient
enviar_empresa_wire.creating_account_sub: This may take a few seconds
enviar_empresa_wire.kyb_body: The recipient needs to complete Bridge's KYB (Know Your Business) verification before receiving wire payments.
enviar_empresa_wire.kyb_after: After completing KYB, come back here to generate the wire instructions.
enviar_empresa_wire.wire_subtitle: Make the transfer from your bank using these details
enviar_empresa_wire.wire_note: Bridge automatically converts and deposits to the recipient's bank. No additional FX markup.
enviar_empresa_wire.done_body: The wire was processed and Bridge is settling the funds to the recipient's bank.
enviar_empresa_wire.form_subtitle: ቀጥታ የባንክ ዝውውር · 1–2 ቀናት · ምንም የካርድ ክፍያ የለም
enviar_empresa_wire.clabe_notice_body: ይህ CLABE ለዚህ ዝውውር ብቻ ነው። ለአዲስ ክፍያ አዲስ የክፍያ ሊንክ ፍጠሩ።
enviar_empresa_wire.delivery_vs: Stripe + Wise ከሚወስዱት 4–5 ቀናት ጋር ሲነጻጸር · ምንም የካርድ ክፍያ የለም
enviar_empresa_wire.tos_body: ኩባንያዎ ከመቀጠሉ በፊት የ Bridge ውሎችን መቀበል አለበት።
enviar_empresa_wire.link_ready_subtitle: Comparte este link con la empresa que te enviará el dinero
enviar_empresa_wire.link_instructions_body: La empresa emisora abre este link, llena sus datos y recibe instrucciones de wire transfer (ACH, SEPA, SPEI). El dinero llega a tu banco en 1-2 días hábiles.

recibir_empresa.title: Business Wire — Receive
recibir_empresa.subtitle: Generate your Wire payment link. Clients can pay you directly from their bank.

recibir_empresa.amount_hint: Amount in your local currency. Minimum $100 equivalent.
recibir_empresa.kyb_body: To receive international wire payments, Bridge requires verifying your business.
recibir_empresa.kyb_after: When Bridge approves your company, come back and your payment link will be ready.
recibir_empresa.polling_body: Bridge is reviewing your documentation. This may take 1–2 business days.
